## FLOOWBOX - Influencer DM Automator
Send influencer handle + niche + followers via webhook.
Perplexity researches their recent content and audience.
GPT-4o writes 3 personalized DM variants:
1. Short and casual
2. Value-first
3. Story-based
Saves to Airtable CRM + posts to Slack for human review.
Always send manually — never auto-send DMs.
